newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Short-term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market continued mixed in a liquid, active system on Thursday.

The market opened with a surplus of Z$830,000 and dealers forecast it would increase to Z$1.2 million after the daily central bank auction at which Z$200 million worth of 91-day treasury bills were taken up by discount houses at 24.47 percent, down slightly from 24.6 percent at Wednesday's auction.
The dealers said NCDs maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 26.5 percent versus 26.25 percent overnight and sold at 25 percent from 26 percent.

Bankers' acceptance bills were quoted at 25.5 percent (buying) compared to 25.25 percent and at 24.5 percent on the selling side from 25 percent while the call rate went up to 24 percent from 22.5 percent.
